question: Why is the mass of reality said to become the cosmic egg?
premises: The mass of reality partakes of the aggregate of Shiva and Shakti.
In its manifestation there is a turning toward.
This turning toward is what is being defined.
inference: Therefore the mass of reality is called the egg because of its oriented manifestation.
uncertainties: The boundary between the two quoted definitions in the verse is interpretive.
plain_english: The mass of reality is said to partake of the aggregate of Shiva and Shakti, and when it turns toward manifestation it is called the cosmic egg.
